name: Pew Pew
tagline: Turns an intrusion-alert log into a network graph with simple anomaly scoring.
problem: Raw security alert files are hard to read.
solution: Parses an intrusion-detection alert file, builds a force-directed graph of hosts and alert signatures, and flags anomalous sources with z-scores.
demo_moment: Team-described: load an alert file and see the busiest attackers highlighted.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “CSE: Network Traffic Exploration” among 261 submissions.
Kept the analysis simple and explainable.

lessons: A sponsor data challenge can be won by a clear, small tool.
